caption: The drawing depicts a single, round bowl with a decorative, ornate handle or crest at the top, featuring cut-out shapes including diamonds, ovals, and a cross-like form. The bowl is shaded in varying tones of gray, providing a sense of depth and curvature, and is centered within a lightly outlined rectangular border. Beneath the main illustration and extending just outside the rectangle, there is a smaller inset diagram that displays the measured dimensions of the bowl in inches: 4 1/2 inches in length, 2 1/2 inches in width, and 2 1/8 inches in another dimension, indicated by arrows and numbers. The background of the drawing is a plain, slightly yellowed off-white color. In the bottom right corner, the name "Charles Cullen" is written in cursive.
title: Pewter Porringer
